task.title: Determining if manual actuals are required

step.cmd: Determine if there is an ROE that falls in the QP with a first day worked that falls before the COD:
Determine if the ROE is a ROE SAT:
Determine if block 15C of the ROE SAT is completed:
Enter the hours as displayed in block 15C of the ROE SAT into the correct pay periods of the Employment History File (EHF) and go to step 16.
Determine if the client will have at least 120 hours if all of the hours on the ROE are included in the QP:
Fact-find with the employer to obtain the actual hours required and go to step 10.
Determine if the employer was reached during fact-finding:
